extract_ngrams: extract n-grams from VizSeqDataSources text data with configurable k and verbose output
create_VizSeqNGrams_instance: create a VizSeqNGrams instance to extract 1- through 4-grams from text data
test_VizSeqNGrams_extract: test the VizSeqNGrams.extract method with sample VizSeqDataSources and k=256
refactor_VizSeqNGrams_extract: refactor the VizSeqNGrams.extract method to support multi-process implementation
summarize_VizSeqNGrams_extract: summarize the VizSeqNGrams.extract method that counts n-gram frequencies up to 4-grams
